why: ADOPTED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 C5): `rcl_get_error_string()` returns `rcl_error_string_t` BY VALUE, `.str` formatted as rcutils does (`"<message>, at <file>:<line>"`, or `"error not set"`). ENVELOPE (stated on the declaration): `RCUTILS_ERROR_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH` is 256 here (1024 upstream), so the by-value return costs a task stack 256 bytes, not a kilobyte; and the record is process-wide (see `c:error_state_t`). Test: `packages/api/nros-c/tests/run/rcl_error_state.c`. PRIOR ROW: the 1024-byte formatted buffer rcl_get_error_string() returns BY VALUE. Same decision as error_state_t; listed separately because it is the half a caller actually touches.
